subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The __loyal__ nature of the princess was one of the reasons that the king trusted her very much.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Treacherous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"loyal"** means giving or showing firm and constant support or allegiance to a person or institution. (वफादार)

 
 
• **Example: **The general was known for his loyal service to the country.
 
 

 
• **"Treacherous" **refers to someone or something that is guilty of or involving betrayal or deception; it is the opposite of being loyal, as it implies a lack of faithfulness. (विश्वासघाती)

 
 
• **Example: **The spy was considered treacherous for selling secrets to the enemy.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'loyal' **is **'treacherous'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Treacherous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Infamous **(कुख्यात): Having a bad reputation.
 
 
• **Example:** The pirate Blackbeard was infamous across the seven seas.
 
 

 
• **Livid **(बहुत गुस्से में): Extremely angry.
 
 
• **Example: **She was livid when she found out her brother had taken her car without asking.
 
 

 
• **Unyielding** (अडिग): Not giving way under pressure; hard or solid.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite the criticism, he remained unyielding in his decision.
